en.headline: Red flags raised at six beaches due to big waves and inclement weather
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department advised beachgoers not to swim at Shek O, Big Wave Bay, Pui O, Hap Mun Bay, Silverstrand and Tai Po Lung Mei beaches on Sunday.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced on Sunday that red flags had been hoisted at six beaches because of big waves and inclement weather.

The affected beaches are Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District, Pui O Beach in Islands District, Hap Mun Bay Beach and Silverstrand Beach in Sai Kung District, and Tai Po Lung Mei Beach in Tai Po District.
Beachgoers were advised not to swim at these beaches. The department regularly monitors conditions and raises red flags when conditions are unsafe.

zh.headline: 六個泳灘因大浪及惡劣天氣懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康樂及文化事務署周日表示，因大浪及惡劣天氣，石澳、大浪灣、貝澳、鹹田灣、銀線灣及大埔龍尾泳灘已懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客不要下水。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周日公布，因大浪及惡劣天氣，六個泳灘已懸掛紅旗。
受影響泳灘包括南區的石澳泳灘及大浪灣泳灘、離島區的貝澳泳灘、西貢區的鹹田灣泳灘及銀線灣泳灘，以及大埔區的大埔龍尾泳灘。
署方呼籲泳客不要在這些泳灘下水。康文署會持續監察情況，在不安全時懸掛紅旗。
